future_boundaries.canonical_test_oracles: tests/wine_integration/oracles is the sole runtime test-owned authority for these retained pure helpers. FEX owner confirmed no duplicate adoption.
future_boundaries.production: Production use of these readers requires a separate reviewed API move from this test package, with consumers and provenance updated. Do not create a second editable implementation.
future_boundaries.excluded: No legacy builder, materializer, signing CLI, native launch loop, old-worktree lookup, or historical receipt replay is imported.
future_boundaries.fixed_recipe_limit: The current candidate inherits exact unselected parent bytes.
